`active_dir.is_dir()` does not establish that the configured collection remains inside `repo`. A relative `collections.active` can be a symlink to an external directory; in `SeriesManifest` mode this external inventory is counted but never compared, so validation can report `Aligned` with files outside the repository. Resolve and reject collection roots before iterating (and before the later `rglob` counts) to preserve the repository boundary.

This issue also appears on line 159 of the same file.

Before entering this inventory path, collection roots have only been compared as raw strings. Distinct values can still be symlinks to the same directory (for example `active` -> `archive`), after which the lexical collection checks can classify a physically archived target as active. Resolve every collection root inside the repository and reject resolved overlaps before this validation runs.
